command: uv run python scripts/measure_slm_slots.py --grounding-accuracy --arm cloud --limit 20 --corpus-dir data/legalbenchrag/corpus/cuad --out .benchmark-reports/ga-cloud-20.json
benchmark_input: data/legalbenchrag/corpus/cuad (CUAD; gitignored, so absent in CI)
notes: Run on this machine with the configured cloud slots, cloud model openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6. This was a local (non-CI) run, so the harness recorded git_sha "unknown" (it reads only GITHUB_SHA); the commit recorded here is the branch tip the run was made at. PII was stripped before every model call (43 entities replaced) with the review path's own strip_pii_clauses machinery, so the clause text and positives are the stripped text sent for cloud egress. Positives and negatives now come in classes that include paraphrases: 30 positives (20 clause qualifying sentences plus 10 lightly rewritten copies) and 50 negatives (20 unsupported_claim + 20 hallucination + 10 paraphrased_unsupported). The labeller's rewrite hit-rate differs from the local arm because this arm runs over CUAD rather than the tracked fixtures: 10 rewrites were kept and 20 skipped here (a rewrite that equalled its source), against 5 kept and 30 skipped on the local fixtures. All three generators' negatives cleared the is_genuine_negative guard (0 dropped). This run is NOT clean: it printed a litellm error/help banner ("Give Feedback / Get Help" and a litellm issues link) before its summary, a transient fault that did not stop the run, and 5 known-good claims came back uncertain where an earlier run on the pre-change code recorded 1. Single-sample smoke measurement, not a benchmark: model replies vary run to run and the arms do not share a corpus. Costs money per run (80 calls this run).
